newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end down as blue chips tumble.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end down as blue chips tumble.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended down on Wednesday as sliding blue chips offset buying in speculative issues and dealers said they expected the index to fall further amid a grim political and economic outlook.
The Karachi 100-share index fell 8.01 points, or 0.56 percent, to end at 1,423.26. Losers led gainers 176 to 74.
"Opposition protests, a troubled economy and conflicting reports about the cotton crop have hit the market hard," dealer Khalid Hussain said. "Foreign funds are sellers in Hub Power."
Hub Power fell 0.50 to 29.70 and Askari Bank 0.70 to 29.90.
